intro: I work directly with founders, small businesses and teams. You talk to the engineer who builds your product, from the first call to launch day and beyond.

services.title: Custom web applications
services.summary: Dashboards, portals and SaaS products built with React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Fast, secure, and easy to grow.
includes: REST or GraphQL APIs on Node.js
services.idealFor: Startups building an MVP, or businesses replacing spreadsheets with a proper tool.

services.title: Shopify stores that sell
services.summary: Custom themes with a distinctive look, mobile-first product pages and smooth checkout, ready for WhatsApp and Instagram traffic.
includes: Payments, shipping and tax configuration guidance
Training so you can run the store yourself

services.title: Workflows & integrations
services.summary: Connect your tools with APIs, webhooks and background jobs so repetitive work runs itself. I've built 50+ of these.
includes: Process review: what to automate first
services.idealFor: Teams losing hours every week to copy-paste, exports and manual hand-offs.

faq.question: How much will my project cost?
faq.answer: It depends on scope. After a short call I send a written estimate that lists what's included, so you know the cost before any work starts.

faq.question: How long does a project take?
faq.answer: Your estimate includes a timeline with milestones. Smaller projects move faster, and I'll tell you upfront if a deadline isn't realistic.

faq.question: How will we stay in touch during the project?
faq.answer: You get regular progress updates and a live preview link, so you can see the work and give feedback early, not just at the end.

faq.question: Can you work on an existing codebase or store?
faq.answer: Yes. I can review what you have, fix issues and add features, or plan a gradual rebuild if that makes more sense.

faq.question: What happens after launch?
faq.answer: I walk you through everything at handover and stay available for fixes, improvements and new features.
